require "test_helper"

class InvoiceTest < Minitest::Test
  def test_render_text_produces_output
    invoice = Invoice.new(lines: [
      InvoiceLine.new(description: "Consulting", quantity: 2, unit_price_cents: 50_000)
    ])

    rendered = invoice.render_text

    refute_nil rendered
    assert rendered.length.positive?
  end
end
params.productionCode:
class InvoiceLine
  attr_reader :description, :quantity, :unit_price_cents

  def initialize(description:, quantity:, unit_price_cents:)
    @description = description
    @quantity = quantity
    @unit_price_cents = unit_price_cents
  end

  def subtotal_cents
    quantity * unit_price_cents
  end
end

class Invoice
  attr_reader :lines

  def initialize(lines:)
    @lines = lines
  end

  def total_cents
    lines.sum(&:subtotal_cents)
  end

  def render_text
    lines.map { |line| "#{line.description} x#{line.quantity}: #{line.subtotal_cents}" }.join("\n")
  end
end

defmodule OrderStateMachineTest do
  use ExUnit.Case, async: true

  alias OrderStateMachine, as: Machine

  test "the happy path reaches the delivered terminal state" do
    {:ok, paid} = Machine.apply_event(Machine.new(), :pay)
    {:ok, shipped} = Machine.apply_event(paid, :ship)
    {:ok, delivered} = Machine.apply_event(shipped, :deliver)

    assert Machine.state(delivered) == :delivered
  end

  test "a pending order can be cancelled and then rejects payment" do
    {:ok, cancelled} = Machine.apply_event(Machine.new(), :cancel)

    assert Machine.state(cancelled) == :cancelled
    assert {:error, :invalid_transition} = Machine.apply_event(cancelled, :pay)
  end

  test "refunded orders reject every further transition" do
    {:ok, paid} = Machine.apply_event(Machine.new(), :pay)
    {:ok, refunded} = Machine.apply_event(paid, :refund)

    assert Machine.state(refunded) == :refunded
    assert {:error, :invalid_transition} = Machine.apply_event(refunded, :ship)
  end

  test "an unknown event leaves the state untouched" do
    machine = Machine.new()

    assert {:error, :unknown_event} = Machine.apply_event(machine, :teleport)
    assert Machine.state(machine) == :pending
  end
end
params.context: Orders are driven by a state machine so that webhooks cannot replay transitions. This module is pure and used by the Order context.
